clusters.requirement: One Controller for the process. remove() = estop, close, drop. Reopen = add() with the remembered config, so a reopened model is never headless. reset() tears everything down BEFORE building. Exit hooks (atexit, SIGINT/TERM/HUP, Qt aboutToQuit, Tk quit) call close() exactly once.
Concerned hide/show, which the owner replaced with destruct-on-close on 2026-09-21.

Close order is halt, de-energize, flush, close port, release gamepad claim. Every step isolated: the hardware step is never skipped because an earlier step raised. Never close a port mid-move without sending the stop first.

Latch before any I/O. Hardware stop on a worker with a bounded join. Returns True only when the stop landed. estop_all fans out one thread per model under one 1.0 s budget, and stops every model before closing any. An unconfirmed stop raises the ONE acknowledged popup naming the models. The latch clears only by operator action, with confirmation.

One write path. Transaction lock plus a separate write-in-flight lock, so a priority byte never interleaves with a frame already on the wire. Priority lane with a lock timeout. abort_if evaluated inside the lock. Bounded flush and write timeouts. A failed write marks the port LOST and raises TransportError; nothing is swallowed. Bytes on the wire are identical to today's (golden-frame test).

Views never setattr on a model. Every command carries the panel's current entry values; Panel.run validates them as a set through Param (type, bounds, decimals) and commits all or none. Refusal names the field. set_value is allow-listed by the schema's writable flag.
The jog loop and the gamepad belong to the model, so manual mode works identically under all three views, the Web included.

One SDL owner. Claims released on close and on relaunch. A swap that fails to bind stops the probe and reverts the selection. Exactly one poll loop per Gamepad (generation guard). flush_neutral really neutralises. Edge events are latched, never dropped between ticks, and read without consuming from another thread. Gamepad loss while MANUAL = halt and disable. 50 Hz jog cadence. macOS disconnect detection re-enumerates.

STILL OPEN today. The layout table is the single place to settle them: exact-name whitelist, T16000M Z/bumper mapping, D-pad sign, deadzone applied once. Each needs the physical pad in hand; the rebuild ports today's values unchanged and marks them unverified. Dropdown live refresh and rebind-after-disconnect are code-closable in Gamepad.options.
is_moving expires by deadline. The idle interlock fires in AUTO and MANUAL on real inactivity (D-3). Restart race: a new watchdog never reuses a dying thread's stop event.
Step stays available while AUTO so repeated stepping works; refused only while is_moving. (This was closed for the Web in the ledger and re-broken in the schema: review finding 5.)
Scripts / G-code purged by owner ruling 2026-09-21.

sys, threading and Tk/Qt exception hooks installed once. Non-destructive since(id) so two browser tabs both see every event. Dedupe window with a repeat count. Popups are marshalled to the UI thread and NEVER opened synchronously inside a close/teardown path. Web escapes every server string (no innerHTML). Handler exceptions return JSON errors.

A command returns a value or raises Refused / NeedsConfirm, so a refusal cannot be reported as success. All three views render Refused. A disconnected or simulated model refuses with a reason instead of going inert.

ONE setup for three views, with autodetection preserved: port scan, handshake identity byte, gamepad list. Scan runs off the UI thread with progress and can be cancelled. Build is all-or-nothing with rollback. The identity byte is checked against the model class. SIM works for every model. A disabled row builds nothing. Probing errors are reported, not swallowed. CLI args are strict.

Models own their loops; views only read state, never the transport. state carries a last-updated age so every view can grey out a stale value. Reader threads back off and recover instead of giving up. Long moves are not capped at 12 s. Status polls never delay a stop.

Tubing confirmation beyond 30 degrees on every move type. A stop forgets the commanded target. Busy guard against stacked moves. (home() must commit its target only after the guard passes: review finding 2.)

Each run freezes its own configuration and owns its log and stop event. Start refuses without a focus area. Thread failure ends the run and reports. Red and change published as one pair. Run identity, output root, sidecar JSON and annotations kept.

No Red Percent view subclasses. One Position Source control wired to set_source. One Save. The probe list follows on_model_added / on_model_removed. remove() autosaves or asks before discarding unsaved data. The live series comes from the model only.

Ledger says closed; today's audit says NOT fit for force approximation. Velocity is differenced across red events against a 10 Hz position cache, and rows are still change-triggered. Needs the owner's two answers (uniform sampling? is 10 Hz a firmware limit?).
STILL OPEN. One drag picker in all three views (Tk has only a typed prompt today; the Web picker is unreachable). Virtual-desktop and display-scaling conversion needs checking on the station PC.

Readouts formatted by Param (decimals, unit) identically in three views. Button and toggle state follows the model, including after FULL STOP. One shared theme: role palette, toggle on/off roles, one base font size. No dead widgets. macOS middle/right-click tab close stays unverified until run on a Mac.
Localhost bind plus Origin/Host check on every state-changing route; JSON content type required.
Dead or legacy state that does not exist in the rebuild.
Architecture docs are rewritten for the new structure; these corrections are moot.

Firmware is untouched by owner instruction. DC board has no coil kill (reported honestly, D-7). Protocol change vs main needs matching firmware (already flashed). D-2 coil-off on stop stands. The Web heartbeat's warn/stop seconds become ONE pair on WebView, still set at the bench.

Gamepad loss while MANUAL = halt and disable. 50 Hz jog cadence. macOS disconnect detection re-enumerates.
